info.title: CommCare HQ API
info.description: REST API of CommCare HQ (Dimagi) — the Data APIs (cases, forms, users, groups, locations, lookup tables, reports), the User APIs, the OpenRosa form submission and OTA restore endpoints, and the spreadsheet upload endpoints. Every path is scoped to a project space (`/a/{domain}/...`) except the two account-level endpoints. Resources are versioned individually: `/a/{domain}/api/<resource>/v1/` is the current form and `/a/{domain}/api/v0.5/<resource>/` the equivalent legacy URL, which CommCare still serves. The OpenFn `commcare` adaptor is a generic HTTP client (get/post/request plus submit, submitXls, bulk and fetchReportData) over this API and pins the v0.5 URLs.

tags.name: Device log

tags.name: Upload
